title: Your Renewal Forecast Needs Receipts
excerpt: Replace renewal confidence percentages with an auditable packet that shows what the customer has decided, what remains uncertain, and what must happen next.
primary_goal: Help CS and Renewals leaders decide whether a renewal forecast has enough current evidence to be credible.
primary_cta: Build one Renewal Evidence Packet before the next forecast review.
playbook_description: An evidence register, forecast-state test, contradiction log, and review record for making renewal forecasts auditable.
